changelog:
Major update: Enhanced PDF extraction with support for structured content, page selection, and multiple extraction methods.

- Now extracts text, tables, and structured content from PDFs using pdfplumber (default) and PyMuPDF.
- Supports flexible page selection (e.g., --pages 1,3-5) for targeted extraction.
- Offers fine-grained control and outputs clean, page-delimited text for LLM analysis.
- Replaces dependency on pdftotext with Python3 and virtualenv-based tools.
- Improved documentation and workflow guidance, detailing best practices and integration with further content analysis.
- Removed legacy file skill-card.md.
